secrets.name: SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Flask session signing key. A development placeholder has been generated; replace with a strong random value for production.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe API secret key for subscription payments. Optional — the app runs without it; only needed to enable paid plans.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe publishable key for the client-side checkout. Optional — only needed for paid subscriptions.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret for verifying Stripe webhook events. Optional.
